example_en: The papaya tree in the garden was laden with fruits.

definition: the power of forming and retaining conceptions and general notions; intelligence; intellect.
example_en: That boy's intellect is sharp.

definition: to oppose; to counteract; to resist.
example_en: People stood up to resist injustice.

definition: that cannot be passed, crossed or traveled over; impassable; narrow; strait.
example_en: That valley becomes impassable during the rainy season.

definition: the part of the body of a mammal between the thorax and the pelvis; the belly; the abdomen.
example_en: He was writhing in pain from his belly.

definition: sugar cast into flat pieces; candied sugar.
example_en: She broke the candied sugar into pieces and distributed it.

definition: a conclusion reached by reasoning: a logical inference; a deduction.
example_en: The logical inference of this sentence is clear.

definition: (pros.) a syllable that is not long; a short syllable.
example: ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗುರು ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ಹ್ರಸ್ವ ಅಕ್ಷರ.
example_en: In prosody, aguru means a short syllable.

definition: that which is flat, broad and fairly thick (as a slab of stone).
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹಲಚೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large flat slab had been laid in front of the house.

definition: the act of taking away of weapons or armaments from; disarmament.
example: ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಎರಡೂ ದೇಶಗಳು ನಿಶ್ಶಸ್ತ್ರೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಂಡವು.
example_en: As per the agreement, both countries agreed to disarmament.

definition: the sound of bellowing (as of a bull, bison, pig, etc.).
example_en: The bellowing resounded in the forest.

definition: to increase or to become more by one thousand times.
example_en: His wealth increased a thousandfold in a single year.

definition: (any itching disease as scabies) to infect (a person).
example_en: Contact with dirty water infected him with scabies.

definition: a wealthy man.
example_en: That wealthy man had a new house built.

definition: (the body or a part of the body) to become putrid, decomposed; to putrefy.
example: ಗಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಸಿಗದೆ ಅವನ ಮೈಹುಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Without proper treatment for the wound, his body became putrid.

definition: a compassionate person.
example: ಆ ಅರುಳಾಳು ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That compassionate person always helps the poor.

definition: a curved piece of wire with a barbed end, for catching fish; a hook.
example_en: The fisherman threw the fish hook into the water.

definition: correct remembrance.
example_en: Her correct remembrance accurately described the event.

definition: having organs; organic.
example: ಈ ಜೀವಿಗಳ ರಚನೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಅಂಗಿ ಸ್ವರೂಪದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The structure of these organisms is completely organic in nature.

definition: persistent annoyance.
example_en: Everyone got tired of his persistent annoyance.

definition: a decorated seat, usu. a long, rectangular plank with short legs, for seating the man and woman who are getting married to each other; a wedding seat.
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ದಿನ ವಧು-ವರರನ್ನು ಹಸೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೂರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: On the wedding day, they seated the bride and groom on the wedding seat.

definition: to remove (an evil, difficulty, pain, heat, agony, etc.).
example_en: The cool breeze removed his fatigue.

definition: with a gulping sound.
example_en: He gulped the drink down his throat with a gulping sound.

definition: a severe mental pain, anxiety.
example_en: The son's illness caused the father severe mental anguish.

definition: to have lustre; to become lustrous.
example_en: After applying oil, the skin becomes lustrous.

definition: fire made on a hearth.
example: ಚಳಿಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಲೆಯ ಇಡುಗಿಚ್ಚಿನ ಬಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕುಳಿತರು.
example_en: In the cold season, everyone sat near the hearth fire.

definition: a leaving, leaving out or excepting; an excluding or being excluded; exclusion; exception.
example_en: His name was excluded from the list.

definition: water boiled for cooking food.
example_en: She kept the cooking water boiling for the meal.

definition: (pros.) a metre having three rhyming lines.
example_en: The tivadi metre was in use in old Kannada poetry.

definition: the blasting sound of crackers or fire arms (when a shot is fired).
example: ಹಬ್ಬದಂದು ಪಟಾಕಿಯ ಢಂಕೃತಿ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿಗೆ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: On the festival day, the blasting sound of the crackers was heard throughout the whole town.

definition: falling within.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯ ಅಂತಃಪಾತಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This matter falls within the list of questions that fall within its scope.

definition: a cart that is drawn by an ox or a pair of oxen.
example_en: The farmer transported the crops in the ox-drawn cart.

definition: (the body) to have well-developed muscles; to become robust.
example_en: Through daily exercise his body developed well-formed muscles.

definition: to ooze, seep out in drops; to discharge oneself, flow out, through the pores.
example_en: Blood was slowly oozing out from the wound.

definition: to put or set in a pile; to heap up.
example_en: He piled the firewood in the courtyard.

definition: to demand strongly; to insist; to persist; to persuade to do; to prevail upon.
example_en: He insisted strongly on the repayment of the loan.

definition: a competition of speed in running, skating, riding, etc.
example_en: A horse race is going to be held on the ground tomorrow.

definition: to observe attentively; to notice or perceive something with special attention.
example_en: The police observed the suspicious person attentively.

definition: joined, united together.
example_en: The two families were united together under the same bond.

definition: to move oneself, in quick motion, back and forth, side to side, etc.; to vibrate; to quiver.
example_en: The leaves quivered back and forth in the wind.

definition: the act or an instance of being depressed; depression.
example_en: The economic depression worried the people.

definition: a very generous man.
example: ಆ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಕಸವರಗಲಿ ಎಂದೇ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That rich man was known in the village as a very generous man.

definition: gracious, propitious words or speech.
example_en: The guru's gracious words soothed everyone's mind.

definition: to bring to an end; to finish; to stop; to conclude; to end.
example_en: They brought the meeting to an end at six in the evening.

definition: a kind of stomach disorder caused by excess secretion of the bile.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಿತ್ತೋದರ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said he has a bile-related stomach disorder.

definition: a broad piece of wooden plank, with or withot legs.
example_en: They chopped vegetables on the wooden plank in the kitchen.

definition: a product of art as a painting, sculpture, literary piece, musical piece, etc.
example_en: A famous work of art is being displayed in that museum.

definition: tranquility; peace; calmness of mind.
example_en: Through meditation, the mind attains peace.

definition: a sheet of paper, embossed with any of various denomination government stamps, for use in recording and registering legal agreements between two or more parties.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವನ್ನು ಛಾಪಾಕಾಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬರೆದು ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Both wrote the agreement on stamped paper and registered it.

definition: to get another's favour; to have mercy.
example_en: The devotee prayed to obtain the mercy of God.

definition: (pl.) (log.) eight kinds of proofs or means of arriving at correct knowledge.
example_en: The eight means of valid knowledge are explained in logic.

definition: a market street.
example_en: Merchants have set up shops on the market street.

definition: the state of being free from death; the state, of quality, of every-living.
example_en: The sages performed penance to attain immortality.

definition: to become intricate, difficult or complicated.
example_en: That problem began to grow more complicated day by day.

definition: a kind of herb.
example_en: This kunji herb is used for medicine.

definition: a rare variety of beryl that is coloured green by chromium and valued as a gem; emerald.
example: ರಾಜನ ಕಿರೀಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿದ್ರತ್ನ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕುಕ್ಕುವಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The emerald in the king's crown shone dazzlingly.

definition: an enemy of the gods; a demon.
example_en: The demon is an enemy of the gods.

definition: the large, spiral, univalve shell of any of various marine mollusks, used as a trumpet; a conch.
example_en: They blew the conch during the worship.

definition: any fungus that attacks various plants or appears on organic matter, paper, leather, etc., esp. when exposed to damp, resulting in a thin, furry, reddish coating or discoloration; mildew.
example_en: The leather bag got mildew during the rainy season.

definition: the quality or fact of being new or novel; newness; novelty.
example_en: The novelty of this painting astonished everyone.

definition: of or belonging to Jina, the Jaina spiritual teacher.
example_en: The Jain temple in that village is famous.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: The fort's dome still stands firmly.

definition: the direction halfway between south and east; the south-east direction.
example_en: The house door should not be placed in the south-west direction.

definition: a tender stalk of a plant.
example_en: He broke the tender plant stalk and made a curry.

definition: the thin, horny substance growing out at the ends of the fingers of people; nail.
example_en: Her fingernails had grown long.

definition: a kind of food.
example_en: Mother prepared the food item for breakfast in the morning.

definition: an act or instance of kissing; a kiss.
example_en: The child gave the father a kiss and bade farewell.

definition: of, related to, grown in a desert.
example: ಆ ಮಾರವ ಸಸ್ಯ ಬಹಳ ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಬದುಕುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That desert plant survives even in intense heat.

definition: (pl.) the five expedients - strategy, human resources, the spacial and time constraints, estimation of effects of retaliatory actions, and achievement of one's aim - a king has to consider while dealing with his enemies.
example: ರಾಜನು ಶಾತ್ರವಮಂತ್ರಪಂಚಕವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅರಿತು ಶತ್ರುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The king, having well understood the five expedients, faced his enemies.

definition: the supposed disembodied spirit of a dead person; a ghost; a spectre.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇದೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹೆದರುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The children were afraid that a ghost appeared in that house at night.

definition: a teaching of morals, political wisdom.
example_en: The teacher gave the disciples a teaching of morals.

definition: heaviness; weight.
example_en: The weight of this bag is too heavy to carry.

definition: a male member of the category of mythical beings in human form with the head of a horse.
example: ಕಿನ್ನರ ಕುದುರೆಯ ತಲೆಯಿಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ದೇಹದಿಂದ ಕಾಣಿಸಿದನು.

definition: a short poetical work.
example: ಕವಿ ಆ ಕಿರುಗಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet composed that short poetical work in a single night.

definition: to be glad; to be elated.
example_en: When he received the prize, he was elated.

definition: any glass article.
example_en: There were colourful glass articles in the shop.

definition: a song sung or meant to be sung in chorus.
example_en: Everyone gathered and sang this chorus song.

definition: turned into or covered with ice; congealed by cold; frozen.

definition: to force to bend (temporarily); to lower by pressure.
example_en: The worker bent the iron rod by pressure.

definition: a string of pearls.
example_en: The string of pearls shone on the queen's neck.

definition: a small box or chest, as for valuables; a casket.

example_en: Grandmother had kept her jewellery in a small casket.

definition: a greyish or brown coloured pigeon.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಚಾವಣಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಹಂಡಬಂಡ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A greyish-brown pigeon sat on the roof of the house.

definition: a giving or taking of one thing for another; an exchange.
example_en: The exchange of money took place at the bank.

definition: a girl or woman servant; a maid-servant.
example_en: The maid-servant was doing housework in that house.

definition: any of large, brownish shorebirds of Numenius genus and Scolopacidae family, with long legs and a long, down-curved bill; a curlew.
example_en: The curlew was searching for insects near the pond.

definition: the symbol or numeral 0, cipher; naught; zero.
example_en: They write the cipher to indicate zero.

definition: an onomatopoeic word imitating the fierce burning sound, occurring repeatedly.

definition: to cause to become sour.
example_en: The milk left in the sun turned sour quickly.

example_en: Nelakanci plants had grown at the foot of the hill.

definition: the liquid that descends from the clouds as rain, forms streams, lakes, and seas, and is a major constituent of all living matter and that when pure is an odourless, tasteless, very slightly compressible liquid; water.
example_en: They gave water to the thirsty man.

definition: the act of collecting. accumulating; accumulation; collection.
example_en: Collecting old coins was his hobby.

definition: rheumatic pain in the lumbar region; backache, esp. in the lower part of the back; lumbago.
example_en: Lumbago is a common problem for elderly people.

definition: a long pace (in walking).
example_en: He walked fast with every long pace.

definition: the chief commander of an army.
example_en: The king's chief commander led the army into battle.

definition: a resting on a knee.

example_en: The devotees sat resting on their knees during the worship.

definition: to teach; to preach; to advise.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciple about righteousness.

definition: urine, the liquid waste excreted from the body.
example_en: The baby passed urine on the bed.

definition: to consider, treat (someone or something) as equal (to another).
example_en: The teacher treated all the students as equal.

definition: wicked; depraved; iniquitous.
example: ಅವನ ವಟರ ನಡತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದಿತು.

example_en: There is a large ship-yard near that port.

definition: any juicy fruit.
example_en: Juicy fruits like mango are more available in summer.

definition: to tear down; to break up or spoil completely; to demolish; to destroy.
example_en: The people demolished the old building.

definition: to get or regain life; to reacquire youthful appearance or strength.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬತ್ತಿದ ಗಿಡಗಳು ಅಸುವಡೆದವು.
example_en: After the rain came, the dried plants regained life.

definition: to scold, reprove strongly.
example_en: The teacher reprimanded the lazy student.

definition: an agreeing to; acceptance.
example_en: The proposal received the meeting's acceptance.

definition: a grasping or seizing (with a hand or both the hands).
example_en: His grip (grasping) was strong.

definition: the pointed top of a mountain or ridge; the peak; the summit.
example_en: The trekkers reached the summit of the mountain.

definition: a yoke provided with a wooden pin that prevents an ox from disengaging itself from the yoke.
example_en: The farmer fastened the pinned yoke onto the oxen.

definition: a kind of net (used by catchers of birds and other animals).
example_en: The bird catcher set the net and caught the birds.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: The teacher woke up the students.

definition: changed; that has become different; undergone mutation; transformed.
example_en: The old building has now been transformed into a library.

definition: a multitude or assembly of scholars, learned persons.
example_en: A great assembly of scholars had gathered at that meeting.

definition: (a cobra) to close the hood that is expanded.
example_en: Frightened, the cobra closed its hood and disappeared.

definition: the sixtieth anniversary of an establishment, event, etc.; diamond jubilee.
example_en: They celebrated our school's diamond jubilee grandly.

definition: beautiful writing; good handwriting.
example_en: Everyone admired his beautiful handwriting.

definition: the act of asking for as charity, kindness, favour, etc.
example: ಆ ಭಿಕ್ಷುಕನ ಬೈಕ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಕರಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The beggar's plea for charity melted everyone's heart.

definition: to move (oneself) to and fro, back to forth or from side to side, in quick succession or repeatedly.
example_en: The leaves began to sway back and forth in the wind.

definition: to become logically integrated, consistent and harmonised.
example_en: All the ideas finally became logically integrated and consistent.

definition: to cause to become insane or mad.
example_en: The despair of defeat made him insane.

definition: across - a) so as to cross; crosswise; b) from one side to the other; c) on or the other side.
example_en: Be careful while crossing the road.

definition: to go aside; to move sideways.
example_en: Seeing the snake, the boy moved aside.

definition: a small pillar or column.
example_en: They had erected a small pillar in front of the house.

definition: a person who helps helpless.
example: ಆ ಅನಾಥಬಂಧು ಬಡ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಕೊಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That helper of the helpless got poor children educated.

definition: bodily comfort.
example_en: He got bodily comfort through rest.

definition: a constructing of a foundation for a wall or structure.
example: ಕಟ್ಟಡದ ಪಾಯಭರಣಿ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗೋಡೆ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: After the foundation work of the building is finished, they will build the wall.

definition: to divide into small pieces or segments and distribute or scatter away.
example_en: They divided the sweets into pieces and distributed them to the children.

definition: a pillow filled with feathers, air, foam rubber, etc. or a soft pad for sitting or kneeling on or reclining against; a cushion.
example: ಅವನು ಟಕ್ಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ತಲೆ ಇಟ್ಟು ಮಲಗಿದನು.
example_en: He lay down resting his head on the cushion.

definition: the hard joint of the stem of a plant (as of jowar, sugarcane, bamboo, etc.).
example_en: The joint of the sugarcane plant was hard.

definition: to become red, reddened.
example_en: Her cheeks became red with shyness.

definition: a householder who is, by nature, gives generously (to others).
example_en: The generous householder always gave food to those who came to him.

definition: a set of chiming bells attached to an ornament, as anklet, girdle, etc.
example_en: The chiming bells on her anklet jingled.

definition: a case for the blade of a knife, sword, etc.; a sheath.
example_en: He put the sword into its sheath.

definition: heaviness as a quality of things; weight.
example_en: The weight of this stone is too much to lift.

definition: a place where tents, huts, barracks or other structures have been put up, as for temporary stay of soldiers; a camp.
example_en: The soldiers set up camp on the river bank.

example_en: Many Sikh families live in Punjab.

definition: a knot that is tied very fast.
example_en: He tightened the rope with a firmly tied knot.

definition: an auspicious day.
example_en: People performed worship as today was an auspicious day.

definition: a worker of inferior rank, employed as a seaman; a khalasi.
example_en: At the harbor, the khalasis were unloading the goods.

definition: a moveable knot of a loop.
example_en: When the movable knot of that rope's loop was pulled, it loosened.

definition: a bailiff - a) an administrative official of a district, having power to collect taxes; b) an official charged in general with the execution of court orders, to serve court notices and to seize a person and to produce before the court, etc.
example: ಅಮೀನನು ತೆರಿಗೆ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮಾಡಲು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: The bailiff came to the village to collect taxes.

definition: to go, move, flow downward.
example_en: The river's water flows downward and joins the lake.

definition: the act of cutting.
example_en: The tailor was skilled at the cutting of cloth.

definition: the physical structure, including the bones, flesh, and organs, of a person; the body.
example_en: His body looked emaciated.

definition: a pounding or beating with a pestle or a heavy object.
example_en: She gave the rice a pounding with the pestle.

definition: a becoming a part of or being included in; inclusion.
example_en: He got inclusion in the association.

definition: screaming of a young woman or women.
example_en: The screaming of the young woman was heard in the silence of the night.

definition: an expression of blame or reproof; abuse; reproach.
example_en: They heaped false accusations of blame on him.

definition: with a gulping sound.
example_en: Thirsty, he drank the water with a gulping sound.

definition: a set of words arranged one below the other as to form a square, in which the letters read alike horizontally and vertically; a word-square.
example_en: The teacher asked the students to construct a word-square.

definition: rice, wheat that is ground to small grits.
example_en: Mother made semolina idli for breakfast.

definition: a secret, usu. evil, project or scheme; a plot.

example_en: People said that they were hatching a plot against the king.

definition: shaken; shivered.
example_en: The leaves of the tree shook and shivered in the wind.

definition: a punishing of a person mistaking him or her as the culprit.
example_en: A wrongful punishment was imposed on the innocent man.

definition: a thin, sharp piece of wood; a splinter.
